scope: Selected fields of original protocol; absolute research paths replaced, no credentials or run transcripts.

original_fields.isolation: Bubblewrap filesystem/PID namespace. Same generic checker/engines in both arms; with_skill alone gets frozen package at /opt/creas/skills/circuit-reverse-rtl. Compatibility aliases contain only engine binaries, not host repository inputs or candidates. No user config, host skills, old candidates, golden RTL or other trials.

shared_validation.backend: complete-domain Yosys JSON bit-parallel supported cells; unsupported cells interleaved complete-domain Icarus replay
shared_validation.replay_partition_rule: ordinary x=offset+t*K; offsets 0..K-1; x<2^n; complete disjoint residue classes

shared_cost.historical_generation_objective: Original V5 scorer immutable; old no-Skill is uniformly measured, never regenerated or reoptimized
shared_cost.new_generation_objective: Same fixed V7 concat-complete core685d and original CSV65a; no score changes for V10

original_fields.comparison_design: Prospective cost-focused Skill-only100 vs immutable original no-Skill reference; within-corpus development across epochs, not concurrent two-arm randomized ablation
original_fields.development_corpus: Same TT100 used in previous development; not heldout generalization
original_fields.final_version_policy: Frozen100; no investigator feedback, selective cases, output imports or failed-agent retries
original_fields.generic_source: Original13 V5 helpers byte-identical; validation original120/120/180 cacheoff; only public cost entrypoint separately frozen V7 concat-complete scorer
original_fields.token_budget: not a hard cap; actual completed-turn usage reported; missing usage stays missing
original_fields.endpoint: V = exact full-interface equivalence AND fixed frontend acceptance; H = V AND audited high-level representation

checkpoint_policy.with_skill: frozen worker atomically publishes first verified final.v; cost refinement has persistent limits of at most two proposals, at most 120 seconds of wall time from the first verified checkpoint, and stopping after two nonimprovements; initial limits may be reduced, never enlarged; only verified lower-cost candidates can replace the checkpoint
checkpoint_policy.with_skill_receipt_reuse: local unchanged candidate/truth/tool/flow/source context receipt only; external proof cache disabled
checkpoint_policy.internal_budget_role: The 240-second generation default and checkpoint limits are frozen Skill treatment behavior inside the same 600-second external budget assigned to both arms.
checkpoint_policy.no_skill: agent may checkpoint candidates using shared generic exact checker
checkpoint_policy.evaluation: terminal final.v only, independently reverified without cache

resource_parallelism_revision.reason: Generation completes before independent evaluation; original budgets and terminal sources unchanged; timings descriptive.
